'default' = value actually stored for a fresh install (AppPreferencesSerializer.defaultValue + upgrade handler on first run); 'uiDefault' = AppPreference.defaultValue shown to the UI where it differs. protoPath is snake_case from WholphinDataStore.proto; JSON name = lowerCamelCase of each segment. screens[].order is the 0-based index inside the group's rendered list (conditional items appended after the group's static items). AUDIT 2026-11: 'defaultRaw' (optional, only on the three subtitle colour prefs) records the raw int32 the serializer writes when it differs from the masked RGB shown in 'default'. Where default != uiDefault a fresh install behaves with 'default' (the stored value); uiDefault is only AppPreference.defaultValue (slider-index / UI-only default).
